answer: Each new identity must solve a fresh VDF over a checkpoint hash seeded by a walnut nonce and pay 4 tokens burned to the grove registry; N fake keys cost exactly 4N tokens per epoch, linear, because every key pays independently. The payer is the key holder, and verification checks the VDF proof and burn receipt; renaming does not reset the loss or reuse the proof, so the burn is irreversible, unlike a returned bond, and the cost ripples across every additional key.
